title: Merry Vale

facts.statement: During the Festival of Hearts, festival favorite characters Rylan and Arianna are waiting in Merry Vale for players.
facts.quote: Rylan, Arianna, and all the festival favorite characters are waiting in Merry Vale for you to join them

article_summaries.title: Festival of Hearts on the PlayStation®3 system
article_summaries.summary: A short official freerealms.com news post announcing that the Festival of Hearts event launched in Free Realms on the PlayStation 3 on the day of posting. It says the festival characters Rylan and Arianna are in Merry Vale, and that Stone Heart and his Heartbreakers are there as antagonists. The exact posting date is not given; the page shows only a relative age ('1 week, 4 days ago') at capture time.
